rows.label: EE MSKPATH3
rows.desc: Log Path3 Masking processing.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE R5900
rows.desc: Log R5900 core instructions (excluding COPs). Requires modifying the PCSX2 source and enabling the interpreter.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE COP0
rows.desc: Log COP0 (MMU, CPU status, etc) instructions.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE COP1
rows.desc: Log COP1 (FPU) instructions.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE COP2
rows.desc: Log COP2 (VU0 Macro mode) instructions.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE Cache
rows.desc: Log EE cache activity.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE Known MMIO
rows.desc: Log known MMIO accesses.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE Unknown MMIO
rows.desc: Log unknown or unimplemented MMIO accesses.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE DMA Registers
rows.desc: Log DMA-related MMIO accesses.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE IPU
rows.desc: Log IPU activity; MMIO, decoding operations, DMA status, etc.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE DMA Controller
rows.desc: Log DMA transfer activity. Stalls, bus right arbitration, etc.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE Counters
rows.desc: Log all EE counters events and some counter register activity.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE MFIFO
rows.desc: Log Scratchpad MFIFO activity.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE VIF
rows.desc: Log various VIF and VIFcode processing data.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE GIF
rows.desc: Log various GIF and GIFtag parsing data.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: EE SIF
rows.desc: Log SIF (EE <-> IOP) activity.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP BIOS
rows.desc: Log SYSCALL and IRX activity.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP Memcards
rows.desc: Log memory card activity. Reads, Writes, erases, etc.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP PAD
rows.desc: Log PAD activity.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP R3000A
rows.desc: Log R3000A core instructions (excluding COPs).

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP COP2
rows.desc: Log IOP GPU co-processor instructions.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP Memory
rows.desc: Log memory access to unknown or unmapped IOP memory.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP Known MMIO
rows.desc: Log known MMIO accesses.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP Unknown MMIO
rows.desc: Log unknown or unimplemented MMIO accesses.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP DMA Registers
rows.desc: Log DMA-related MMIO accesses.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP DMA Controller
rows.desc: Log DMA transfer activity. Stalls, bus right arbitration, etc.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP Counters
rows.desc: Log all IOP counters events and some counter register activity.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP CDVD
rows.desc: Log CDVD hardware activity.

rows.heading: TRACE LOGGING
rows.label: IOP MDEC
rows.desc: Log Motion (FMV) Decoder hardware unit activity.

rows.heading: GRAPHICS DEBUGGING
rows.label: Use Debug Blend
rows.desc: Forces SW blending and disables several optimizations.

rows.heading: GRAPHICS DEBUGGING
rows.label: GS Dump Length
rows.desc: Determines how long Record GS Dump in the pause menu records. A heavy scene produces several hundred MB a second, even compressed.

rows.heading: GRAPHICS DEBUGGING
rows.label: GS Dump Compression
rows.desc: Change the compression algorithm used when creating a GS dump.

rows.heading: GRAPHICS DEBUGGING

rows.heading: PS5 TUNING
rows.label: Prioritize Audio and Input
rows.code_label: Sound and controls before the emulator
rows.desc: Gives sound, controllers and menus priority over the emulator, and runs downloads and copies after it. Prevents crackling and late button presses.

rows.heading: PS5 TUNING
rows.label: Fast Shader Compilation
rows.desc: Draws new effects with a quickly built shader first, then switches to the optimized one. Reduces stutter the first time an effect appears.

rows.heading: PS5 TUNING
rows.label: Fast Writes to Console Storage
rows.desc: Large files written to the console's storage (texture packs moved or downloaded there, disc images) are written by a helper program the title starts, which the console does not slow down after the first 1.3 GB as it slows the title. If the helper fails, the title writes the rest itself, at its own speed.

rows.heading: NATIVE CODE MODULES (EXPERIMENTAL)
rows.label: Use Native Code Modules
rows.desc: Runs a game's code from a native module built with the recomp kit from your copy of the game. May cause issues in some games.

rows.heading: NATIVE CODE MODULES (EXPERIMENTAL)
rows.label: Export Executables
rows.desc: Copies a game's executable to the network share when no module exists, so the recomp kit can build one.

rows.heading: NATIVE CODE MODULES (EXPERIMENTAL)
rows.label: Allow Hardware Access
rows.desc: Allows native modules to access the console's hardware directly. Disable it if a game hangs with its module.

rows.heading: NATIVE CODE MODULES (EXPERIMENTAL)
rows.label: Verify Native Code
rows.desc: Runs every function twice and compares the result with PCSX2's interpreter. Greatly reduces performance; for debugging only.

rows.heading: THE CONSOLE
rows.label: Threaded Graphics Driver
rows.code_label: Graphics driver on its own thread
rows.desc: Runs the graphics driver on a CPU thread of its own. Usually faster in demanding games.

rows.heading: THE CONSOLE
rows.label: Streamed Memory Clearing
rows.desc: Clears newly allocated graphics memory with non-temporal writes instead of clearing and flushing it. Reduces the time spent creating textures.

rows.heading: THE CONSOLE
rows.label: Graphics Memory From the Top
rows.desc: Places the graphics driver's memory at the top of the console's memory, its small pieces apart, so they don't break up the free memory between large render targets. Prevents running out of graphics memory at high resolutions, with texture packs, and after playing several games.

rows.heading: THE CONSOLE
rows.label: Skip Unchanged Microprograms
rows.desc: Keeps the VU1 recompiler's programs when a game uploads microcode that equals what VU1 already holds. A game that changes microcode while VU1 runs it may draw wrongly. Not yet tested on a console.

rows.heading: THE CONSOLE
rows.label: Coarse Thread Times
rows.desc: Threads note their processor time at most once a millisecond instead of each time they wake. Reading it is a system call on the console. The thread loads shown may lag by up to a millisecond of work.

rows.heading: THE CONSOLE
rows.label: Wake-Up Spin Time
rows.desc: Determines how long a thread waiting for work keeps checking before it sleeps. Longer can wake threads sooner and costs processor time.

rows.heading: THE CONSOLE
rows.label: GPU Wait Spin Time
rows.code_label: Wait for the GPU: checking for
rows.desc: Determines how long the driver keeps checking whether the GPU is done before it starts sleeping between checks.

rows.heading: THE CONSOLE
rows.label: GPU Wait Sleep Time
rows.code_label: Wait for the GPU: sleeps of
rows.desc: Determines how long the driver sleeps between checks while waiting for the GPU.

rows.heading: THE CONSOLE
rows.label: Profile Next Start
rows.desc: Records detailed performance data on the next startup and writes it to "crux2-boot.log". Helps find out why a game is slow.
